WELCOME TO THE VALLEY

From three, a civilisation.

There is no finish line. Shape a place, watch your people make it their own, and grow at your own pace.

  1. Make a home. Choose a shelter below and click a clear patch of ground. Materials are reserved immediately; your settlers do the building.
  2. Find your rhythm. People gather timber, food, and stone, carry it back, and look after their own needs. Toggle work priorities to guide them.
  3. Grow your way. Gardens renew food. Storehouses shorten journeys. Wells supply water. Workshops improve gathering. Spare housing and 24 food attract settlers.

Drag to move · Scroll or + / − to zoom · WASD / arrows to pan · Home to return · Space to pause · 1–6 to build · Escape to observe. On touch screens, drag to pan and pinch to zoom.

Prototype sandbox: up to 12 settlers. Hunger slows work but nobody dies. Your valley saves on this device every 30 seconds. “Save” also creates a checkpoint you can return to with “Load”.
